Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Ayaan - 12 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Kavita - 42 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
3. Naira - 10 years, daughter
Look: yellow frock, two plaits
4. Savitri - 70 years, grandmother
Look: pale blue saree, white hair

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
3. The park - green grass, swings, benches

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Ayaan stands in the living room. Kavita stands near him.]

Kavita: "Ayaan, what's the plan today?"

[Ayaan eats his breakfast at the table.]

Kavita: "Wow, how lovely!"

[Ayaan drinks a glass of water.]

Ayaan: "Mom, listen!"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Ayaan stands in the courtyard. Kavita and Savitri stand near him.]

Kavita: "So, here we are!"

[Ayaan coughs.]

Ayaan: "Hmm, I see."

[Dark clouds gather in the sky.]

Kavita: "And then?"

Scene 3: The park - Day

[Ayaan stands in the park. Kavita and Naira stand near him.]

Ayaan: "So, here we are!"

[Ayaan goes jogging in the park.]

Kavita: "That was fun!"

[Ayaan throws the ball to Mother.]

Ayaan: "Careful!"

[Ayaan kicks the football hard.]

Kavita: "Hey, look at that!"

[Ayaan swings on the swing.]

Ayaan (surprised): "One more time!"

[Ayaan plays on the see-saw with Mother.]

Ayaan: "And then?"

[Ayaan feeds the birds.]

Ayaan (excited): "Slowly, take it easy."

[Ayaan does yoga on a mat.]

Ayaan (excited): "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
